channel_axis_nulls.note: sorted pairing of the channel axis nulls regardless of the tolerance; the wall cusps are the gated quantity, the axis nulls are where the iron moves the separatrix root

outside_channel_axis_nulls.note: axis nulls outside the straight section (anode side / exit / downstream) sit in the un-cancelled end field where the iron yoke and poles act most strongly; they are reported, not gated

comparison.tolerance_rule: tolerance_m(design) = max(wall_radius_m / bore_elements, l1a_dz_m) = max(r_w / 8, 0.0004514): one level-0 P2 bore element (two level-1 bore elements), never below the L1a axial grid step; 0.45-0.53 mm over the 15 designs

evidence.identity_basis: case rebuilt from the preregistered sweep-v3 Sobol design; geometry / source / config / case hashes equal the sealed sweep-v3 design authorities and the sealed L1a record; L1a record bytes equal the sweep-v3 manifest

sampling.axis_window: the sealed L1a record's axis_window_m is used verbatim for every P2 map so both fields are searched on exactly the same axial window; the sampling grid must contain it with the v3.1 margin (2.5 x mesh scale) or the design fails
sampling.statement: the P2 solution is sampled on a regular grid r = 0..r_w in 32 intervals (h = r_w / 32, 0.07-0.13 mm), z from (domain z_min + h0) to (domain z_max - h0) with h0 = r_w / 32 and dz = the largest step <= h giving an integer interval count; psi = r A_phi, B_r = -dA_phi/dz, B_z = A_phi / r + dA_phi/dr (axis: 2 dA_phi/dr); shared-edge nodes average the element traces. The REFINED map is the same level-1 solution sampled at 2x (64 radial intervals, dz / 2): the sampling / interpolation stability check of the v3.1 P2 set. The COARSE map is the level-0 solution sampled at 1x. Every sampled map is post-scaled by the design's L1a source_strength_scale (exact for the linear problem) so L1a and P2 carry the same magnet strength.

solver_controls.backend: numpy CSR PCG (IC0 below 15000 free DOFs, Jacobi above); CPU only, no CUDA, no Warp
solver_controls.package: cft_revival.fem_reference (adapters.graded_mesh_geometry, solver.solve, adaptivity.estimate_indicators / component_dorfler_mark, mesh.refine_mesh, solver.prolong_p2_solution)
solver_controls.statement: the controls of the fem_reference qualification campaign (examples/fem_reference/run_reference_campaign.py: relative_tolerance 2e-10, max_iterations 16000); a solve is converged iff the true residual acceptance holds (FEMResult.diagnostics.converged)
